name: Human liver serial sections, 3D (LYNX NIH_F5)
description: Seven serial Xenium sections of human liver sample NIH_F5, 5 µm apart (01 to 08; the deposit has no section 03), on the 377-gene Multi-Tissue panel. Each section opens in its store's aligned coordinate system, which registers its cells to section 04, so the sections line up side by side and stack in 3D. Only section 04 shows its morphology image: the others' are rotated in that frame.

source.citation: Jin Y et al. (2026) LYNX: a deep generative model for linking spatial dynamics and cell interactions in multimodal spatial data. bioRxiv. doi:10.64898/2026.07.09.737574
